t_advice_summary_textbox.text: I am going to pick the green, yellow, orange and blue gnomes until the number of mushrooms gets to 1, 2 or 3. Then I will pick the other colour gnomes so I can go to another forest and get an increased amount of mushrooms.

vb_textbox.text: Remember these colours: Green, yellow, orange and blue. The green, yellow, orange and blue coloured gnomes take you to one forest and the other coloured gnomes ( red, purple, etc) to a different forest. You want to get as many mushrooms as you can. To do this, select the green, yellow, orange or blue gnome as they appear but once you see that the amount of mushrooms has got to 1,2 or 3, swap to the other colours as they will increase in mushrooms. Once the other coloured mushrooms start to decrease, then go back to the green, yellow, orange and blue. This will give you a better chance of getting more mushrooms and a higher score. Take note of the 1st screen with the gnomes where says x1,x2,x3 etc. You will need to use this information so you can see when the score is getting low. For example, if the amount of mushrooms is 5 then you might think that is ok, however if it was a x5, then that means the original number of mushrooms must have been 1 ( as 1 x 5 = 5).
